79 of 96 heads clear the 2% band-mass floor

Exact add-one permutation p, BH-FDR across 79 scanned heads
Same neighbourhood, different wavelengths, different evidence
Kogan splice-junction phasing: real, but its wavelength is not identifiable at its coherence length
measured in DNA, not in the model

The multi-species carrier is NOT the measured nucleosomal periodicity - the two differ by 0.33 nt, and the model's is fitted to +/-0.005. Its biological or training origin remains unresolved. At 400 permutations BH needs >= 4 heads at the p-floor before any is called significant.
